derivation:
by
  change ⊤ ∉ s ↔ s ⊆ Set.Iio ⊤
  rw [Set.Iio_top, Set.subset_compl_comm]; simp
explanation: Set.Iio_top identifies the elements strictly below ⊤ with the complement of {⊤}. Applying this characterization to inclusion of s gives the result using routine set simplification. Its proof uses only lt_top_iff_ne_top, independently of the target.
